decision.scope: Conversations Boilerplate Reduction initiative attestation and its module-level release evidence only.
conditions: SM-1 and SM-2 measurements are accepted as directional evidence; this decision does not mark their unconfirmed target interpretations as passed.
Projection read-store population remains deferred and is not represented as proven by this decision.
The retained Conformance.Tests to Server coupling remains disclosed and requires its documented follow-up path.
The compiled xUnit v3 executable fallback is accepted for the recorded sandbox validation where the preferred dotnet test runner aborted before executing tests.
This decision does not approve or assert inherited platform controls, security certifications, penetration testing, key management, vulnerability disclosure, external audit, or platform compliance.
Any change to either bound source file, the source commit, or the signable payload hash invalidates this decision and requires a new release-owner decision record.

signature.signatureMechanism: Repository-recorded release-owner attestation; no PKI or cryptographic-signature claim.
signature.statement: The release owner approves the bound success-metric report and attestation for this release with the recorded residual risks and scope limitations.
